name: Buenache de Alarcón (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Buenache de Alarcón (quartered with a castle, a tower and a cross, within a bordure of roundels).
history: Municipal flag of Buenache de Alarcón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
